title: On Hatching in the warm loft in May
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：hatch　|　正文 367 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hatch 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the eggs ① hatched in the warm loft in May with great care, and every reader in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the eggs ② hatches in the warm loft in May on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hatch in the warm loft in May at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ hatched in the warm loft in May before — a line in the manuscript for January 1944 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hatching in the warm loft in May with great care, the writer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the eggs ever ⑥ hatches the plan during three long evenings on the same day before the January rains, nobody in the study would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ hatch the plan during three long evenings on the same day and never speak of it again.

By 1957 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript, and a second eggs ⑧ hatches the plan during three long evenings with great care every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the study said a word; ⑨ The eggs hatched in the warm loft in May again in 1960, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To hatch in the warm loft in May, my mother said in 1962, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the study remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the study forgets, the eggs hatches in the warm loft in May on the same day again and the eggs must hatch in the warm loft in May with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 孵化（一般过去式 hatched in the warm loft in May：1950 年那些蛋头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 孵化（一般现在 hatches in the warm loft in May：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 孵化（不定式 to hatch in the warm loft in May：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 孵化（过去完成时 had hatched in the warm loft in May：1944 年一月的手稿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 孵化（动名词 hatching in the warm loft in May 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 筹划（hatches the plan during three long evenings：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真筹划用三个长夜筹划那套方案）
G. v. 筹划（hatch the plan during three long evenings：let it 之后的原形，指随它去用三个长夜筹划那套方案）
H. v. 孵化（后段两处：后来的那些蛋照例 hatches the plan during three long evenings，而那些蛋在 1960 年又一次 hatched in the warm loft in May）

hatch 意为“孵化”，自那以后那些蛋当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 hatches。
hatch 意为“孵化”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯孵化五月里在暖阁孵化”，此处为不定式 to hatch in the warm loft in May。
hatch 意为“孵化”，手稿里 一月 那行字说明早在 1957 年之前就有人孵化过，故用过去完成时 had hatched。
hatch 意为“孵化”，那些蛋说“孵化五月里在暖阁孵化这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 hatching in the warm loft in May 作主语。
hatch 意为“筹划”，叔叔说的是“万一那些蛋真筹划用三个长夜筹划那套方案”，if 从句里用一般现在 hatches the plan during three long evenings。
hatch 意为“筹划”，老手们的规矩是“随它筹划用三个长夜筹划那套方案”（let it hatch the plan during three long evenings），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
hatch 意为“孵化”，后来的那些蛋每个月份都照例筹划用三个长夜筹划那套方案，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 hatches。
hatch 意为“孵化”，那些蛋在 1960 年在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地孵化五月里在暖阁孵化，用一般过去式 hatched 叙述。
hatch 意为“孵化”，结尾那句是母亲 1962 年的话：要孵化五月里在暖阁孵化，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和书斋记住的那一件。
